accepted_answers.name: pytest
accepted_answers.why: The expected addition is a pytest suite itself: the single-file tool has real, testable behavior (CLI parsing, server selection, output formatting) with zero automated coverage.

notes: Baseline commit 22210ca35228f0bbcef75a7c14587c4ecb875ab4. Component pointer: speedtest.py (single-file CLI; no test_*.py anywhere, tests/ holds only scripts/source.py). Baseline proof: `pytest -q` exits 5 (no tests ran); `python speedtest.py --help` renders the argparse CLI, so the component is live and testable. tests is honestly [] per schema (nothing exists yet; attw authors the suite, critic judges it non-tautological). No swap: matches proposed run 6 exactly.
problem: A widely used single-file network tool ships with no automated tests, so regressions can only be caught by hand.

verify.test_command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider . (suitevenv python, run from repo root; exit 5, no tests collected)
